business_summary: China Southern Power Grid Energy Storage Co., Ltd. engages in the development, investment, construction, and operation of pumped storage, peak-shaving hydropower, and energy storage activities. The company was formerly known as Yunnan Wenshan Electric Power Co.,Ltd. China Southern Power Grid Energy Storage Co., Ltd. was founded in 1997 and is based in Guangzhou, China.
business_summary_ko: China Southern Power Grid Energy Storage Co., Ltd.는 양수 저장 장치, 피크 절감 수력 발전 및 에너지 저장 활동의 개발, 투자, 건설 및 운영에 참여합니다. 이 회사는 이전에는 Yunnan Wenshan Electric Power Co.,Ltd로 알려졌습니다. China Southern Power Grid Energy Storage Co., Ltd.는 1997년에 설립되었으며 중국 광저우에 본사를 두고 있습니다.
